Based on the university's attendance requirements, to appear for the end-term examination, the minimum attendance required is **seventy-five percent (75%)** of the classes actually conducted in every course the student has registered for in the academic term (Attendance Requirements, Clause 7.2).

Even with this special approval, the minimum attendance requirement can on no account be less than **sixty-five percent (65%)** of the classes actually conducted in every registered course (Attendance Requirements, Clause 7.3).

According to university rules, if you or your family member(s) suffer serious medical exigencies involving hospitalization, trauma, or a contagious disease, you may submit a leave request with documents to your Faculty Advisor for recommendation to the Program Chair, subject to the approval of the Vice-Chancellor. 

You can be given additional relaxation in attendance for the course(s) where there is a shortage. These must be submitted on the day you rejoin classes, alongside raising a medical leave request on the Digii portal by uploading all documents. Failing this, leave on medical grounds will not be accepted. Note that medical certificates are considered for the entire day, not for specific classes or hours.

*(Source: University Attendance Regulations / SOPs)*
